FAQ

Who owns the website and domain?

You do. The domain and hosting account are in your name.

What do I need to send?

Start with your business details and what you want visitors to do. The website form guides you through the rest.

What are the yearly costs?

With free hosting, expect to pay about S$20 a year for a standard .com domain. Renewals vary by domain and provider. The website build is a one-time fee.

I can set up free hosting for a basic site on Cloudflare Pages in your account. Some hosts charge based on traffic, and features like databases or paid tools can add costs. I’ll flag any expected charges in your quote.

Support is optional. Pay per edit or choose deployment management at S$49 a year or Website care at S$89 a year. See help after launch

How do I pay?

You can pay via PayNow. I’ll share the payment details once we agree on the quote.

Can I change things later?

Yes. You can update the site yourself or ask me to make changes. Quick fixes like typos are free, and other edits cost S$3–25 depending on the work. Website care includes five edit requests a year.
